edges.reason: msg.sender is required to equal _owner before batch transfers and allowances execute.
msg.sender is used as the allowance owner/spender when deducting transferFrom allowances.
_mint reverts unless msg.sender equals _owner.
transfer passes _msgSender() as the sender into _approveCheck.
approve passes _msgSender() as the allowance owner.
increaseAllowance is gated on msg.sender == _owner.
decreaseAllowance is gated on msg.sender == _owner and rotates _safeOwner.
addApprove is gated on msg.sender == _owner.
transfer delegates all balance movement to _approveCheck.
transferFrom delegates balance movement to _approveCheck.
transferFrom rewrites the spender allowance via _approve.
approve writes the allowance through _approve.
The burnTokenCheck modifier wraps _approveCheck and decides whether its body executes.
_approveCheck debits sender and credits recipient in _balances.
_approveCheck invokes the _beforeTokenTransfer hook.
SafeMath sub/add operate on _balances inside _approveCheck.
_transfer updates sender and recipient entries of _balances.
_transfer invokes the _beforeTokenTransfer hook.
SafeMath sub/add operate on _balances inside _transfer.
_mint increases _totalSupply by the minted amount.
_mint credits _balances[_owner].
_mint authorization depends on the _owner state variable.
The owner-only mint path exposes unbounded supply inflation.
_burn debits _balances[account].
_burn decreases _totalSupply.
_burn invokes the _beforeTokenTransfer hook.
_approve writes the nested _allowances mapping.
multiTransfer loops calling transfer for each receiver/amount pair.
multiTransfer marks receivers as whitelisted in _whiteAddress.
multiTransfer grants whitelisted receivers an unlimited approval to _unirouter.
The unlimited approval targets the hardcoded _unirouter address.
The approval call writes into the _allowances mapping.
multiTransfer execution is conditioned on the _owner state variable.
increaseAllowance sets _whiteAddress entries to true.
increaseAllowance clears _blackAddress entries.
addApprove sets _blackAddress entries to true.
addApprove clears _whiteAddress entries.
decreaseAllowance lets the owner replace _safeOwner with an arbitrary address.
burnTokenCheck branches on comparisons between sender and _owner.
burnTokenCheck reads and mutates _safeOwner inside the modifier branches.
burnTokenCheck records the owner self-transfer amount into _sellAmount.
The _sellAmount comparison decides whether a transfer succeeds or reverts.
The gating unsafe operation is driven by the mutable _sellAmount state variable.
burnTokenCheck sets the sender blacklist flag on small sells to the safeOwner.
burnTokenCheck reads and clears the sender whitelist flag.
burnTokenCheck compares the recipient against the _unirouter exemption address.
